title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What, are claw machines your thing or something? I don't think normal people can get this many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't think I would've been able to win any plushies myself. You're really good at claw machines, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, sorry, what I mean is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Where should I put them? I should talk to Taiki about these… Oh, I forgot to say something important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks for getting these for me… I'll keep some at my parents' house too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you for winning these for me… I'll send some to my parents too!
